title: Build Clubhouse Home, Parent Portal Dashboard, and Tours & Interviews Booking Pages

requirements.text: Create a cohesive, playful visual theme across the app that matches a family-friendly “interactive digital playground” brand: rounded bubble-like containers, warm sunny palette (avoid blue/purple as the primary scheme), playful star/butterfly accents, and consistent typography and spacing.

quotes:
Concept 1: The "Clubhouse" Home Page
 * The Vibe: An interactive digital playground.
 * Key Feature: A giant "Join the Club" button instead of a boring "Book Now."
 * Visual Style: Rounded "bubble" containers, playful star accents from her logo, and a hero image that looks like a sunny park.
Concept 2: The "Parent Portal" Dashboard
 * The Vibe: Secure but still vibrant. It should feel like a "VIP Lounge" for parents.
 * Key Feature: The Nanny Cam takes center stage here, framed with a fun border so it doesn't look like a clinical security feed.
 * Layout: Quick-glance icons for "Nap," "Snack," and "Play" so busy parents can see status updates instantly.
Concept 3: The "Tours & Interviews" Booking Page
 * The Vibe: Low pressure, high excitement.
 * Key Feature: A "Meet Auntie Maia" video or photo area next to the calendar.
 * Visual Style: We’ll use the butterflies and stars from her logo as "stickers" scattered around the booking calendar to make the scheduling process feel less like a chore."

acceptanceCriteria: All three pages share the same design language (rounded bubble containers, consistent palette, consistent typography).
Primary palette is not predominantly blue/purple.
Star/butterfly decorative elements appear in a consistent style across pages.

requirements.text: Implement the “Clubhouse” Home page with a sunny-park hero section and a prominent, giant “Join the Club” call-to-action button as the primary interaction.

quotes:
Concept 1: The "Clubhouse" Home Page
 * The Vibe: An interactive digital playground.
 * Key Feature: A giant "Join the Club" button instead of a boring "Book Now."
 * Visual Style: Rounded "bubble" containers, playful star accents from her logo, and a hero image that looks like a sunny park.

acceptanceCriteria: Home page includes a hero image visually resembling a sunny park.
The primary CTA is labeled exactly “Join the Club” and is visually dominant on the page.
Home page uses rounded bubble containers and star accents in the layout.

requirements.text: Create navigation/routing so users can reach the three experiences: Clubhouse Home, Parent Portal Dashboard, and Tours & Interviews Booking page from the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: There are working routes/pages for Home, Parent Portal, and Tours & Interviews.
Users can navigate between all three pages via visible UI navigation (e.g., header buttons/links).

requirements.text: Implement the “Parent Portal” Dashboard with a secure “VIP Lounge” feel, featuring a nanny cam feed/video area as the centerpiece with a playful, non-clinical frame/border, plus quick-glance status widgets/icons for “Nap”, “Snack”, and “Play”.

quotes:
Concept 2: The "Parent Portal" Dashboard
 * The Vibe: Secure but still vibrant. It should feel like a "VIP Lounge" for parents.
 * Key Feature: The Nanny Cam takes center stage here, framed with a fun border so it doesn't look like a clinical security feed.
 * Layout: Quick-glance icons for "Nap," "Snack," and "Play" so busy parents can see status updates instantly.

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard visually emphasizes the nanny cam area as the main focal element and includes a playful frame/border around it.
Dashboard includes three distinct quick-glance status widgets labeled exactly “Nap”, “Snack”, and “Play”.
Backend provides an API to read the current values/timestamps for Nap/Snack/Play statuses and the nanny cam media URL (or placeholder).
Frontend fetches and displays statuses from the backend and shows a nanny cam area (real URL if configured, otherwise a clear placeholder).

requirements.text: Add a minimal access-control flow for the Parent Portal so it feels “secure”: require Internet Identity sign-in before viewing the dashboard, and show a friendly sign-in screen/state when not authenticated.

quotes:
Concept 2: The "Parent Portal" Dashboard
 * The Vibe: Secure but still vibrant. It should feel like a "VIP Lounge" for parents.

acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to access the Parent Portal while signed out displays a sign-in prompt and does not display portal content.
After signing in with Internet Identity, the Parent Portal page becomes accessible.
No edits are made to immutable Internet Identity hook files; authentication is composed using existing hooks/components.

requirements.text: Implement the “Tours & Interviews” Booking page with a low-pressure, exciting feel: include a booking calendar UI and a “Meet Auntie Maia” photo/video area placed next to the calendar, with star/butterfly sticker-style decorations around the calendar region.

quotes:
Concept 3: The "Tours & Interviews" Booking Page
 * The Vibe: Low pressure, high excitement.
 * Key Feature: A "Meet Auntie Maia" video or photo area next to the calendar.
 * Visual Style: We’ll use the butterflies and stars from her logo as "stickers" scattered around the booking calendar to make the scheduling process feel less like a chore."

acceptanceCriteria: Booking page includes a calendar-style scheduling UI.
A “Meet Auntie Maia” media area (photo or video) is displayed adjacent to the calendar on desktop widths and stacks sensibly on mobile.
Decorative star/butterfly sticker visuals appear around the calendar area without obstructing usability.

requirements.text: Add backend support for creating and listing booking requests from the Tours & Interviews page (e.g., select date/time and submit), and display a confirmation state in the UI after submission.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes methods to create a booking request and list booking requests for the signed-in user (by Principal).
Frontend can submit a booking request from the calendar UI and shows a clear confirmation after successful submission.
Booking requests persist in canister state and are retrievable on refresh.

requirements.text: Place generated image assets in the frontend as static files and render them on the appropriate pages (hero image on Home; stickers and frames on Parent Portal and Booking page).

quotes: hero image that looks like a sunny park
playful star accents from her logo
butterflies and stars from her logo as "stickers"

acceptanceCriteria: All generated images are stored under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Home page uses the generated sunny park hero image.
Parent Portal uses the generated fun frame around the nanny cam area.
Booking page uses the generated sticker assets around the calendar area.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no multi-canister backend).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not edit immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
Use English for all user-facing UI text.
nonGoals: Implementing real-time streaming/video infrastructure for the nanny cam (use a configurable URL/embed or placeholder).
Integrating third-party auth providers other than Internet Identity.
Payments, subscriptions, or online checkout flows.

Set of playful butterfly sticker illustrations (varied sizes, warm colors) (stickers-butterflies-set.dim_1024x1024.png)
Fun rounded “frame” border graphic suitable for wrapping a video/feed area (nanny-cam-fun-frame.dim_1200x800.png)
